_comment: Copy to config.json (or specify another path via the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable). This file contains only two items, database and skill_dir; all other configuration such as LLM is set through environment variables or in-app settings, not in this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > this file's database. Choose one of two forms: (A) fill in the individual fields below; (B) fill only database.dsn with a single complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): remove the database block above and use a complete DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each containing SKILL.md). Priority: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ alongside the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
